label: assertion
text: For the FaceForensics++ dataset (a dataset of 11,600 training images from face-cropped frames of 400 videos with varied compression and deepfake generation artifacts), ResNet-18 pruned with Iterative Magnitude Pruning (IMP) using local (per-layer) thresholds (20% weight removal per iteration for 8 rounds, Adam lr=$1\times 10^{-4}$, early stopping patience 10) retains 83% test accuracy at 80% sparsity, outperforming both its dense baseline and the same network pruned using global thresholds. Thus, local pruning yields superior preservation of critical layer-specific features on compressed, challenging datasets.
